items.evaluation_contract: exact-v1 `h3 1.7 Relation to Prior Long-Context Evaluations [id=—]` 的可复算范围是：BEAM [3] stress-tests whether a frontier LLM can remember across coherent multi-session dialogues, and shows that even 1M-token models degrade as dialogue lengthens. CSTM-Bench tests a complementary question: given the same kind of long, coherent, multi-session stream, can a correlator around the LLM detect adversarial latent structure before it lands? The Full-Log Correlator in CSTM-Bench inherits BEAM’s degradation regime as cumulative token pressure grows (§4.5).
